title: Nordle checks record
description: The record of how a post was checked, kept at <project>/checks/<doc id>.json. A post is only 'verified' when every required check passed at the document's current version, by more than one checker.

check.description: design = critique score; technical = verify; copy = caption and alt text; compliance = pack rules; facts = every phone, address, price, name and number in the words comes from facts.json or the brief; media-match = every caption/text claim is true of the photo or clip it sits on; speech-cuts = no speaker cut off mid-sentence; broll = cutaways make sense for what is being said; audio = levels, ducking, music; brief = does it do what the idea asked; uniqueness = no repeated photo or hook within the month.

by.description: auto = a script; designer = the Claude that built it; reviewer = a separate Claude that did not build it and looked fresh; owner = the person.

v.description: The document version that was checked.

hash.description: Short fingerprint of the document file that was checked. A document rebuilt from a spec keeps its version number, so the fingerprint is what shows an old check no longer applies.

rule.description: Short id of the rule that raised this, e.g. ahpra-dental/painless.

pairs.description: media-match: for each piece of media, what the words say and what the picture shows, and the verdict.

time.description: Video only: where on the timeline (seconds) the media is shown.
